strengths: Disciplined luxury-CAD HUD with clean responsive reflow across desktop and 700x900 narrow viewports without overlaps.
Clear visual storytelling across Hero, annotated Macro, and isometric Exploded CAD modes with convincing Côtes de Genève and perlage surface motifs.
defects_and_ai_tells: 2D/2.5D vector-gradient aesthetic lacks true 3D geometric thickness; exploded CAD layers reveal flat, paper-thin planes instead of extruded mechanical solids.
High draw-call overhead (927 draw calls for 6,004 triangles) alongside an 8.8s navigation ready time indicates unbatched scene nodes and heavy initialization.
Macro callout leader lines cross busy high-contrast gear geometry, slightly reducing immediate visual clarity.
actionable_r2_fixes: Batch or instance static movement components (gear teeth, screws, jewels) to reduce draw calls below 100 and improve frame pacing in Macro/Narrow views.
Extrude bridges, gears, and bezels with beveled 3D thickness and environment-mapped PBR metals so the exploded CAD view reads as solid precision hardware.
Optimize startup asset/procedural generation to bring navReadyMs under 2.5 seconds.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 고급 시계 공학 컨셉의 UI 구성과 반응형 레이아웃, 다각도 분석 모드의 기획력은 준수합니다. 다만 평면적인 2.5D 그래픽 질감과 과도한 드로우콜 및 초기 로딩 지연은 전시급 3D 엔지니어링 기준에 미치지 못하므로 지오메트리 입체감과 렌더링 최적화가 필요합니다.

strengths: Refined luxury editorial typography and HUD hierarchy that reflows cleanly without overlap on narrow viewports.
Clear isometric exploded view with legible callouts and real-time torque cascade telemetry.
Crisp procedural horological surface treatments, including mainplate perlage and bridge striping.
defects_and_ai_tells: Components appear as paper-thin 2D planes lacking physical thickness and beveling, most evident in the exploded stack.
Synthetic 2D linear and radial gradients on the bezel, lugs, and sapphire crystal read as vector illustrations rather than PBR metals and glass.
Severe draw-call overhead (935 draw calls for 7,179 triangles) degrades live performance, visibly dropping the HUD counter to 33–49 FPS across views.
The 'DRAG THE CROWN TO WIND' prompt remains visible in Exploded mode despite the case and crown being hidden.
actionable_r2_fixes: Merge and instance gear/plate geometries to reduce draw calls under 100 and eliminate frame drops in Macro, Exploded, and Narrow views.
Extrude movement plates, bridges, and wheels in 3D with angled chamfers and HDRI environment reflections to replace flat 2D gradients.
Synchronize contextual UI prompts with view states so crown interaction hints hide or adapt when the case assembly is hidden.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 고급스러운 타이포그래피와 반응형 HUD 설계는 안정적이나, 부품의 두께감과 빛 반사가 결여된 평면적 그래픽 한계가 뚜렷합니다. 과도한 드로우 콜 병목을 최적화하고 실제 3D 돌출 형상 및 PBR 재질을 도입해 입체감을 보완해야 합니다.

strengths: Cohesive period-inspired HUD design with clean responsive scaling on narrow viewports.
Clear mechanical readability of the central tape apparatus synchronized with the 2D register.
Sharp, legible typography on 3D chalkboard diagrams, gauges, and desk documents.
defects_and_ai_tells: Noticeable shadow map banding and aliasing across the wooden desk and green blotter.
Blocky, untextured exterior architecture and props lacking grounding contact shadows.
Slow 12.1s initialization time alongside HUD-reported frame drops (35–41 FPS) in alternate views.
actionable_r2_fixes: Adjust shadow bias parameters and add screen-space or baked contact shadows to ground desk props.
Defer off-critical-path texture generation to reduce load time and profile shader bottlenecks.
Refine PBR roughness variation on wood/brass surfaces and improve exterior window silhouettes.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 시대적 분위기를 살린 UI와 직관적인 튜링 머신 상호작용이 잘 구현된 준수한 작업물입니다. 다만 책상 위 그림자 아티팩트, 단순한 창밖 기하 구조, 초기 로딩 지연에 대한 기술적 보완이 필요합니다.

strengths: Clean multi-stage turbofan cutaway geometry featuring distinct cross-section hatching and well-proportioned blade arrays.
Crisp, high-contrast aerospace telemetry HUD that reflows cleanly to the 700x900 narrow viewport without overlap.
Effective exploded thermal mode with clear 3D spatial callouts and axial temperature mapping.
defects_and_ai_tells: Airflow particle streamlines ignore collision boundaries, clipping straight through solid rotor hubs and nacelle walls.
Combustor macro view relies on flat, streaky additive gradients rather than convincing volumetric flame or heat distortion.
Severe frame-pacing stutter (fpsP10 at 12 FPS, ~32 FPS shown in hero HUD) and sluggish initialization (6938 ms).
PBR metallic materials lack micro-surface roughness variation and ambient occlusion in tight blade roots.
actionable_r2_fixes: Constrain streamline paths to the annular gas-path volume so particles wrap around hub/casing contours without clipping.
Profile CPU/GPU bottlenecks to eliminate the 12 FPS P10 drops and reduce the ~7s load time via asset/shader pre-compilation.
Upgrade combustor visuals with animated noise-driven volumetric shaders and add SSAO to ground dense blade stages.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 정밀한 단면 형상과 깔끔한 반응형 엔지니어링 HUD가 돋보이는 터보팬 시각화 결과물입니다. 다만 입자 흐름의 지오메트리 관통 현상과 하위 10% 프레임 저하(12 FPS) 및 긴 초기 로딩 속도는 개선이 필요합니다.

strengths: Cohesive single-pass GLSL hex-lattice curl-noise shader with strong blackbody/plasma color grading.
Well-structured spreadsheet UI metaphor in Mode B featuring live cell inspection, formula bar integration, and zero narrow-viewport overlaps.
defects_and_ai_tells: Severe P10 frame drops (14.9 FPS) and sluggish initialization (4104ms navReady, 3111ms pre-warm).
Explicit AI-tell branding hallucination ('MODEL GEMINI-4-ARGON') visible in the bottom-right footer.
Flat, step-quantized transitions in the Hex Flame macro view lacking true volumetric depth or specular beveling on individual tiles.
actionable_r2_fixes: Eliminate synchronous pre-warm stalls via progressive frame accumulation to stabilize P10 FPS above 50 and cut load times.
Strip fabricated model telemetry strings from the HUD footer.
Add analytical per-hex normal bevels and a lightweight dual-Kawase bloom pass to elevate surface tactility.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 독창적인 헥스 격자 셰이더와 스프레드시트 UI의 결합이 돋보이나, 초기 로딩 지연과 하위 10% 프레임 저하가 아쉽습니다. 하단의 가상 모델명 표기를 제거하고 타일 입체감 및 연산 최적화를 보완하면 완성도가 크게 향상될 것입니다.

strengths: Clean, cohesive brass-and-emerald HUD with proper responsive collapse on narrow viewports and zero console errors.
Clear XPBD cloth collision deformation paired with an informative wireframe debug mode and real-time energy ledger.
defects_and_ai_tells: Retro arcade cabinets in the background clash thematically with the brass-and-wood kinetic atelier aesthetic.
Severe performance stutters (12 FPS P10) and slow initialization (10.8s navReadyMs) despite low geometry counts.
Flat lighting and missing contact shadows leave dominoes, tracks, and stands looking ungrounded on the wood surface.
Camera framing in the narrow viewport centers on spent dominoes rather than the active Stage 8/8 funnel and bell.
actionable_r2_fixes: Profile and optimize the 120 Hz physics/render loop to eliminate 12 FPS P10 frame drops and reduce the 10.8s load time.
Add contact shadows or SSAO and refine PBR roughness maps to properly ground the brass and wood mechanisms.
Replace discordant background arcade props with atelier-appropriate scenery and dynamically track active stages on narrow screens.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 정교한 UI 구성과 XPBD 천 시뮬레이션 시각화는 준수하나, 배경 오브젝트의 테마 부조화와 심각한 하위 10% 프레임 저하(12 FPS)가 완성도를 낮춥니다. 물리 연산 최적화와 접지 그림자 보강을 통해 시각적·기술적 안정성을 확보해야 합니다.
